title: Daily advice #22. What to answer eBay Customer Support if you ask or have any accounts?
description: Addition: If you are advanced and ensure that there is no connection between accounts, you may not admit it.  eBay / dropshipping training and services: https://dropshipcourses.com/ Open Dropshipping Facebook Group: https://bit.ly/395pxwh Official Facebook page: https://bit.ly/391Suq Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aivaivabay/  #ebay #ebayaccouns #ebaycustomersupport

asr.full_text: Hello, this is Hebra. Today's topic is about if you are calling eBay and you find out that you have a problem. And eBay asks if you have any other connections, and you know that you have, you would register your name or add the same password, which is a very strong link. So never lie't try to insult them. If they give you a question, they will see it for sure. And if we lie, it's their identification that we are playing some kind of games here. If it's completely different person's name, different type of shirt, and so on, the idea doesn't match at all, you can say that you don't have it, but if it's somehow connected, then you better tell them, because otherwise there will be problems.
